subject: ClearCart: sustained p99 spike + errors during live checkout — possible client SDK parsing issue
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures / huge p99 spike this morning

Hi Marissa,

We're seeing a sustained p99 latency increase and a bump in 5xxs for live checkout starting ~08:45 PDT. This is affecting ~12% of requests and causing timeouts on our side. Our SDK team hasn't pushed changes, but the ClearCart client library is using Redwood's streaming client.

Sample error from our side: "streaming parser: unexpected header boundary" and several truncated payloads. Can you take a look? This is blocking our peak traffic window.

I attached a short capture and some application logs. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior SRE, ClearCart
[attachment: clearcart-logs-20270821.tar.gz (log archive)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Checkout failures / huge p99 spike this morning

Jonas / Rishi — forwarding ClearCart. They report parser-level errors and truncated payloads. They run our client SDK embedded in their checkout proxy.

Immediate ask: can eng reproduce from the logs? Jonas, can you triage streaming parser + header boundary handling first? If it's the SDK we need a hot patch and rollback plan. Rishi / Naomi, please prepare an exec summary and customer status update.

I'll be on standby and can join any customer call.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Checkout failures / huge p99 spike this morning

Marissa — looking now. Initial quick note: the error string Alex sent lines up with a known edgecase where chunked transfer encoding splits an HTTP header across frame boundaries and the SDK parser fails to reassemble the header name before header parsing. We thought the last fix covered it, but the reproduction matrix didn't include very small MTU-like fragmentation patterns.

Can ClearCart share a short capture of the raw bytes (preferably the first failing request)? If not, ask them to enable SDK debug logging (frame boundaries + header assembly) — I listed the flag below.

Temp mitigation ideas: 1) route critical checkout traffic to our dedicated region/proxy (avoids their embedded path), 2) disable streaming for SDK clients of that service until we ship a fix (requires app change). I will prioritize a reproducer and patch.

Debug flag: REDWOOD_STREAM_DEBUG=frames,headers

-Jonas
Principal Engineer, Runtime
[internal note: start a repro job on low-MTU fragmentation harness]

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@clearcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearcart.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout failures / huge p99 spike this morning

Marissa / team — attaching the raw capture and a trimmed client trace. The most common failing request hits the streaming path when we proxy several small frames from our edge. We also included the SDK client frames file.

Attachments: sdk-client-frames.txt (frame-level dump)

We can flip their traffic to an alternate route if you need us to. We're on-site for peak and this is urgent.

Thanks,
Claire
Engineering Manager, ClearCart

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec escalation: ClearCart production impact — need leadership visibility

Rishi / Naomi — Jonas confirmed a plausible parser edgecase in our SDK that matches their capture. We need leadership visibility: ClearCart is seeing revenue impact during their US morning peak.

Ask: please review and escalate to VP Eng + Customer Success. Rishi — please prepare a short customer-facing note (apology + mitigation + ETA). Naomi — plan for a credit / goodwill package and CS outreach cadence. Jonas is reproducing and will prioritize a patch and can provide a hotfix build.

I will coordinate a bridge at 12:00 PDT and be on the call with the customer.

--
Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai; Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearcart.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@clearcart.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Fix landed to mainline; hotfix artifact + rollback plan

Hi all — quick update from eng: we reproduced the ClearCart failure with the frag-harness and confirmed the root cause: header-name tokens split across frame boundaries were being treated as separate header start events by the streaming parser. The fix ensures incremental header reassembly before tokenization and adds a unit/integration test for sub-MTU fragment sequences.

Hotfix: v1.14.2-hotfix (runtime streaming parser) — artifact available at https://artifacts.redwood.ai/release/v1.14.2-hotfix (sha256: ab12...9f0). We validated on the frag-harness and with ClearCart's sample capture.

Rollout plan:
- 09:15 PDT: push hotfix to edge proxies that service ClearCart only (canary 5% traffic)
- 09:45 PDT: expand to 50% if no regressions
- 10:30 PDT: full rollout across their traffic path

Customer mitigation: recommend ClearCart temporarily route critical checkout traffic to our dedicated proxy (we can cut a route immediately) while we canary. Naomi / Rishi — please confirm the communication copy and compensation details.

I'll monitor the canary and share traces.

-Jonas
Principal Engineer, Runtime
[attachment: release-notes-v1.14.2-hotfix.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearcart.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@clearcart.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearCart: sustained p99 spike + errors during live checkout — possible client SDK parsing issue

Alex / Claire — thank you for the quick turnaround on the capture. We deployed v1.14.2-hotfix and immediately saw a drop in p99 and error rate in your canary traffic. Jonas will continue monitoring and we will roll to full traffic per the plan tomorrow morning if the canary stays green.

Customer next steps: 1) we recommend you keep the alternate route until 10:30 PDT tomorrow when we plan full rollout; 2) our CS team (Naomi) will follow up on credits and a formal RCA; 3) we'll share the hotfix artifact and test cases so your SDK team can validate locally.

Apologies again for the disruption — we'll follow up with a formal executive summary.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
